trace.observation: Instruction: [SEP] i'm looking for furniture to make my living room and dinning room so nice [SEP] Back to Search [SEP] < Prev [SEP] Pallet Wood- Upcycled Living Room Coffee Table - Vintage, Rustic Look Made with 100% real wood. Every table starts with very rough pallets- the more weathered the better! Pallet wood is usually rough-sawn with multiple nail holes etc. using a combination of hardwoods (mostly Oak). I bust the pallets apart using the support pieces to make the table frame and the slats for the top and shelf. The nails are removed and the gnarly pieces are then sawed, ripped, cut to size, and drilled. Then sanded- just enough to remove the splinters, but not too much to remove the character of the wood. So you'll get a piece of hand-built furniture with very interesting original saw marks, knots, gouges and brandings which make every table unique. I put it together reusing the salvaged spiral nails and traditional furniture making techniques with hidden pocket screws to make a nice, heavy-duty, solid table. It's stained a beautiful dark walnut color- and finished with multiple coats of hand-rubbed Danish Oil. Dimensions: 40" Wide x 23" deep x 19" tall and with a full size shelf underneath the top. Comes partially disassembled. Easy assembly requires a cordless drill or 1/4" driver (I'll include the bit and instructions). If you like the vintage look of a weathered hand-built piece of furniture then you'll love this table! Please contact me if you have any questions. BTW- See my other listings for matching end tables. I also offer the tables unfinished if you want to paint or stain it yourself, and do custom work. Contact me if you have a cool idea for a pallet project!
